Summary: Write problem statement, objectives and scope
Description: Describe the sanitation-reporting problem in Kigali, list SMART objectives, and state what is in and out of scope. Output: section 1 of the SRS and slide 2-3 content. Estimate: 3h.

Run a short survey or interviews with residents, cell leaders and cleaning companies (at least 10 answers). Summarise findings with numbers. Output: stakeholder table and data summary for slide 3. Estimate: 4h.
Technical, economic, operational and schedule feasibility of the API. Output: feasibility section of the SRS and slide 4. Estimate: 3h.
Functional requirements (one per endpoint group), non-functional requirements (security, performance, availability), actors and use cases. Output: SRS document. Estimate: 5h.
Project name, purpose, objectives, scope, team, milestones, success criteria, approval. Output: charter in the project plan document. Estimate: 2h.
Break the project into deliverables and tasks (WBS) and build a schedule up to 30 Nov 2026 (Gantt chart). Output: project plan document and slide 5. Estimate: 3h.
Estimate costs: hosting, domain, internet, team hours, devices; show free-tier choices. Output: budget table in the project plan. Estimate: 2h.
List risks (deadline, hosting outage, data loss, team absence, merge conflicts) with likelihood, impact and response. Output: risk table and slide 7. Estimate: 2h.
Define each member's role, the channels used (WhatsApp group, Jira comments, GitHub PR reviews, weekly meeting) and how changes are approved. Output: slide 6. Estimate: 1h.
Express 5 app with folder structure (routes, controllers, services, middleware), npm scripts, environment config with NODE_ENV, .env.example, health check endpoint and README. Estimate: 3h.
Serve docs/swagger.yaml with swagger-ui-express at /api-docs and the raw document at /api-docs.json. Document the health endpoint and the shared Error schema. Estimate: 1h.
404 handler for unknown routes and one error middleware that returns {error:{status,message,details}}, maps PostgreSQL errors to 4xx codes and hides internals in production. Estimate: 2h.
PostgreSQL pool from DATABASE_URL (TLS in production) and scripts/migrate.js that runs new SQL files in db/migrations in order and records them in a schema_migrations table. Estimate: 3h.
Tables districts and sectors (sector belongs to one district, FK). Unique names. Seed the 3 Kigali districts and their 35 sectors. Estimate: 2h.
Tables categories (unique name) and users (unique email, password hash, role admin or officer, optional sector FK, active flag, timestamps). Estimate: 2h.

Tables reports (FKs to category, sector, assigned user; status and priority checks; reference code; coordinates) and report_updates (FK to report with cascade delete, FK to user). Add indexes for common filters. Estimate: 3h.
scripts/seed.js loads locations, categories, one admin and two officers (hashed passwords) and about 15 sample reports with history. Safe to run twice. Estimate: 3h.
Reusable validate() middleware that checks body, params and query against rules and returns 400 with a list of field errors. Estimate: 2h.
POST /api/auth/login (bcrypt check, returns JWT), GET /api/auth/me, and middleware requireAuth and requireRole. JWT_SECRET from the environment. Swagger bearer auth. Estimate: 4h.
GET /api/districts, GET /api/districts/{id}/sectors, GET /api/sectors. Document in Swagger. Estimate: 2h.
GET list and one (public); POST, PUT, DELETE (admin only). Validation, 404, 409 on duplicate name or category still in use. Document in Swagger with schemas and error responses. Estimate: 3h.
Admin manages staff accounts: list, get, create, update, deactivate/delete. Never return password hashes. Document in Swagger. Estimate: 4h.
POST /api/reports (public, generates reference code) and GET /api/reports with filters (status, category, sector, date) and pagination. Document in Swagger. Estimate: 4h.
GET /api/reports/{id}, GET by reference for residents, PUT/PATCH (staff), DELETE (admin). Document in Swagger. Estimate: 3h.

PATCH /api/reports/{id}/status records who changed it and why in report_updates, sets resolved_at; GET /api/reports/{id}/updates lists the history. Only allowed status moves. Document in Swagger. Estimate: 3h.
GET /api/reports/stats: counts by status, category and sector, average time to resolve. Used for the evaluation slide. Document in Swagger. Estimate: 2h.

Summary: API tests: auth, categories and users
Description: node:test + supertest tests including validation and error cases, run against TEST_DATABASE_URL. Estimate: 3h.
Tests for report create, list filters, update, status history, delete and error cases. Estimate: 3h.
Check every setting comes from environment variables, NODE_ENV=production behaviour (logs, error messages, TLS), no secrets in git, render.yaml blueprint. Estimate: 2h.
Create the Render PostgreSQL database and web service from GitHub, set environment variables, run migrations and seed, confirm /api/health and /api-docs work online. Add URLs to README. Estimate: 3h.

Summary: Live Swagger test run and demo script
Description: Test every endpoint on the production Swagger, including at least one validation error, and write the 5-minute demo order. Estimate: 2h.
Check the finished system against the objectives and SRS, record results and lessons learned. Output: slide 10. Estimate: 2h.

Summary: Pitch: value proposition, market and competitors
Description: Who benefits and how, market size (Kigali households, districts, cleaning companies), comparison with current ways of reporting. Output: slide 9. Estimate: 3h.
Build TeamName_SPEPL401.pptx with exactly the 10 slides required in Section C and rehearse within 8-10 minutes. Estimate: 4h.
